        KNOW THE BLOCK

        How to play

        Getting around

        Play shows today's daily run, your streak, the next game you can unlock and every game. Pick one and press Play now. Rankings has a board for every game plus the Arcade Level board. Friends holds challenges, your pack's new personal bests and your friends list. Me is your player card, stats, DAWG and settings.

        Controls

        After Hours: pick a verb (Look, Talk, Take, Use…), then tap a glowing spot in the scene. To use or give an item, pick it from your pockets first. You can also type commands, like the classics: use comb on mirror, give whiskey to rufus, howl. Stuck? Ask for a hint.

        Keyboard: arrow keys or WASD, Space to jump or flap, P to pause, V to switch first and third person, Esc to leave. Touch: swipe in the maze, snake, Cross and Dash, tap to flap, and hold the left or right side of the screen in Neon Pinball and Drift Dawgs. On-screen buttons are there too; change the layout in Controls.

        Levels and unlocks

        Every finished run earns XP. Maze Munch, DAWG Dash, Flappy DAWG and Daily Run are open from the start. Each other game opens when you reach its level, play for long enough, or keep a daily streak, whichever comes first. Locked cards show what opens them.

        Friends, challenges and rankings

        Share your friend code or invite link, or add a friend's code on the Friends tab. Challenge a friend from their card or from any game: they get your best score as the one to beat. Turn off “Show me on public boards” on the Me tab to stay off public boards and feeds.

        Your DAWG

        Your DAWG plays every game with you, earns XP and trains its stats. Open My DAWG on the Me tab to adopt more, name them, dress them in the atelier and compare them in the circuit league.

        Saving

        Progress saves on this device and, as a guest, to the cloud. Add your email under Cloud save to keep it if you switch devices. You can also export a backup file.

        Credits

        Karts, cars, buildings, track-side props, furniture and shop fittings by Kenney (kenney.nl). Night-city lighting from the Shanghai Bund HDRI by Greg Zaal (Poly Haven). All CC0. Everything else is original to the DAWG Arcade.

          YOUR PROGRESS, EVERYWHERE

          Account & cloud saves

          Connecting…

          You’re playing as a guest. Add your email to keep your progress if you clear this browser or switch devices. We send a one-time link; there’s no password.

          What we store and why

          Your save sections (records, characters, settings, progress), your finished runs (game, score, play time, day) and which games you have unlocked, so your progress follows you and play walls can open. Your email only if you add it. Data travels over HTTPS and is encrypted at rest; each player can only read their own data. Nothing is sold or shared. “Delete my cloud data” removes all of it from our database.

          YOUR PACK. ANYWHERE.

          Keep your progress.

          Export records, rep, settings, story progress, Street Hustle, and unfinished runs as a JSON file. Import that file in your local copy to pick up where you left off.

          Files stay on your device. Import asks before replacing existing progress.

          CAREER NEVER EXPIRES

          Build your edge.

          3 starter points. Every level earns 2 more. Train six attributes up to 25. Appearance opens advanced fashion in Fashion / 3D. New runs lock in your DAWG and training; paused runs keep their original setup. Daily Run always uses standard rules.

          Recent completed runs

          Your pack.

          Characters and rankings save in this browser. Export a character to copy its identity and career to another device. Full save backups include your entire kennel and unfinished games. Imported characters are unverified local records.

          DAWG ATELIER / DRESS TO IMPRESS

          Build a look. Own the room.

          Body, clothes, hardware, dyes. Preview anything; equip the fashion you have unlocked.

          CANVAS STUDIO
          YOUR 2D GAME LOOK

          Studio lighting brings out soft shadows, woven fabric, satin and metallic hardware on your full-body DAWG. Export the shared skeleton, weighted torso and limb garments, and Idle / Walk / Run clips as GLB. Accessories stay rigid. Dash uses sprites rendered from the same 3D asset; the other games keep their 2D style.

          Birth genome

          A public deterministic seed. Changing fashion changes your look hash, not your DNA or career. Hashes do not prove exclusive ownership.

          Your rotation.

          3 SAVED OUTFITS / CHARACTER
          MEET YOUR NEXT MAIN CHARACTER

          Different by DNA.
          Legendary by play.

          Coats, fits, headwear, glasses, accessories, colors, body shapes, and signature crests combine into a vast procedural collection.

          Each new identity starts with 128 secure random bits; domain-separated SHA-256 derives a versioned genome. Duplicate imports are rejected. Visual similarities remain possible; finite traits cannot promise infinite unique appearances.

          Rarity is cosmetic. Every DAWG starts with the same total attribute points and can reach level 50. No wallet, purchase, token, or resale value is involved. Your kennel holds 24 characters.

          YOUR KENNEL / THIS DEVICE

          The circuit league.

          Compare your real saved characters by Circuit Points, level, or Flex. Appearance training, equipped fashion tiers, palette harmony, mastery, and saved outfits build Flex. This league is local to your device.

          How rankings and growth work

          Flex is a separate 0–1,000 fashion score: Appearance × 10, equipped item tier totals × 3, palette harmony × 1.5, 5 per mastery badge, and 10 per saved outfit. It grants no extra game score. Each game contributes up to 1,000 circuit points from that character’s best completed score, for 9,000 total. Targets: Maze 5,000; Rush 3,000; Daily 3,000; Hustle $20,000 net worth; Flappy 300; Cross 600; Snake 600; Dash 2,500; After Hours 1,200. Replaying improves a best; it does not stack leaderboard points.

          Ranks: New Blood → Street Regular at 1,000 → Circuit Pro at 3,000 → Night Legend at 6,000 → Hall of Fame at 8,500. Circuit ties use lifetime XP, then DNA. Career benefits are allowed; Daily always stays standard.

          Positive completed runs earn 20–200 base XP, scaled to each game’s target. The first score at 25% of a target adds 75 XP once per game. Story XP can grow with Charm. Hustles must last at least 3 nights to earn XP. Zero-score runs earn none. Level 50 is the cap; careers have no expiry, paid boosts, or login streaks.

          These are device-local, editable saves, not verified online results. Sharing a character file copies it. A future online competition needs server-backed identity, verified results, and its own fair-play rules.

          Your active DAWG plays new runs. Build a career at your own pace.
